title.quote: B LOCK C ONTEXTUAL MDP S FOR C ONTINUAL L EARNING

extractions.description: The paper introduces the Block Contextual MDP (BC-MDP) framework for continual reinforcement learning, addressing non-stationarity and rich observation settings. It proposes a novel algorithm (ZeUS) for zero-shot adaptation in non-stationary environments, leveraging Lipschitz properties for generalization.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper addresses challenges in reinforcement learning related to non-stationarity and adaptation, it does not explicitly focus on sustainable development themes.
